reviews.decision_reason: The selection boundary preserves all supplied corpus rows that meet the explicit demand-score threshold and fallback path. In this semantic-only package, no raw market-demand evidence is present to independently validate the demand scores, so market-demand substantiation cannot be judged here.

The normalization boundary retains only the allowed record identifiers, normalizes required fields, and applies the bounded eight-row window without changing the selected handoff records. The package omits direct market-demand evidence behind the scores, so those claims remain unvalidated rather than inferred.

The provenance assembly boundary deterministically ranks normalized needs by demand_score descending with record_id as tie-breaker and emits the evidence source handoff records used downstream. That preserves the ranking needed for the downstream recommendation; no behaviorally significant fault is visible in the supplied source/output/log package.
